name: Torr2Jelly
description: Standalone TorrServer torrent streaming & Prowlarr/Torznab integration for Jellyfin
overview: Stream torrents instantly on Jellyfin without waiting for downloads. Features embedded zero-config TorrServer daemon, Prowlarr search, and automated .strm library generation.

versions.changelog: Initial standalone release with embedded TorrServer daemon and Prowlarr integration.
